snippet.title: I Made an Incremental Farming Game With Creature Collection for My Wife ❤️ | Incremon Trailer
snippet.description:
🌱 WISHLIST INCREMON ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5501000/Incremon/

Incremon started as a small prototype I made for my wife. She enjoyed it so much that we decided to work on it together, polish the idea, and turn it into a full game. What started as a little project between us has grown into a cozy incremental farming game with creature collection that we're now excited to share with you! ❤️

So, what is Incremon?

Incremon is a cozy idle and incremental farming game with creature collecting at its heart. Capture roaming Incremons, collect different species, take care of them, and combine them into stronger evolutions to increase your farm's production.

There's plenty to do yourself, too! Head out into the Outskirts to chop trees, mine crystals, and collect carrots. Meanwhile, your Incremons keep harvesting resources back at the farm, so your progress doesn't stop when you step away.

🐾 MEET YOUR INCREMONS

Each species has its own job:
• Bluwies mine Crystals.
• Pwinkies collect Carrots.
• Yewies chop Wood.

✨ WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Capture and collect different Incremon creatures.
• Feed your Incremons and combine them into stronger evolutions.
• Build and expand your own farm.
• Gather Carrots, Wood, and Crystals.
• Upgrade your production and improve your creatures.
• Complete quests and earn rewards.
• Trade resources with the Travelling Merchant.
• Enjoy a mix of active clicking and idle farming.
• Keep your farm running in a small window while you do other things.
• Continue growing your farm even after completing the quests.

If you enjoy creature collecting games, incremental games, idle games, clicker games, cozy farming games, or resource management games, we hope you'll find something to love in Incremon!

📅 PLANNED RELEASE: March 11, 2027

Made with love by Doomasher Games Studio.
